summary: Added read-only PreviewComparison and surface-matrix projection for multi-origin app previews, with composite pairing keys, safe same-origin route provenance, UI pair count/details, and focused route-scrubbing tests.

integrated_findings: Removed bare version-id pairing risk by using project/family lineage keys.
Hardened same-origin path scrubbing against protocol-relative paths, backslashes, and token/session query parameters.
Added route provenance fields and avoided status_url as comparison surface route.
Added regression tests for unrelated same-version projects and unsafe route scrubbing.
Typed PreviewComparison fields in the cockpit model.
Added existing-Metric pair count and existing-PathRow selected comparison details without CSS changes.

validation.note: Vite emitted the existing large chunk warning only.

control_boundaries: PreviewComparison records register comparable surfaces only; they do not capture screenshots, DOM, AX, console, network, or visual diffs.
Comparison authority is read-only and does not inherit provider launch, interaction, capture, stop, deployment, or accepted-state capabilities.
Protocol-relative, backslash, tokenized, and direct loopback URLs are not emitted as comparison routes.
VM, remote, and viewer-local runners remain registered provider classes only; no runner launch authority is granted.
